name: @strivio/mcp-gateway
stderr:
strivio-gateway <command> [--config <path>]

  version                      print the gateway version
  init                         write a starter config (does not overwrite)
  validate                     check config, key file, and downstream registry
  enroll --intent <id>         enroll this gateway with Strivio (generates the key locally)
  tools [--json]               report downstream tools to Strivio for approval in the dashboard
  health                       verify the key loads and Strivio is reachable
  serve                        run the MCP gateway over stdio (for your MCP client)
